svg.title: By the numbers
svg.desc: 5 YRS: Shipping production systems, from large team codebases to teams of one · $338K: Invoiced through the billing platform from my first month on it, 99% collected · 55 %: Of a fintech super-app's message service: 7,276 of 13,196 source lines, and 89% of its tests · 1,374: Tests on a hotel system I built alone, more test code than application code

g.text: Tests on a hotel system I
